knowledge:
- key_parameters: mitochondria_symbol=Regular expression used in add_metadata() to identify mitochondrial genes (e.g., "^MT-") ;; min_nsamples=Minimum number of non-zero expressing samples in remove_variables() to retain a gene ;; min_nReads/max_nReads/min_nGenes/max_nGenes/min_percMT/max_percMT=Quality control thresholds in remove_samples() for filtering low-quality cells ;; min_meannReads=Minimum mean read count across samples in remove_variables_second() to filter out low-expression genes ;; min_ngenes/max_ngenes=Limits in remove_signs() for the number of genes allowed in a biological term ;; th_posi/th_nega=Positive and negative correlation thresholds in cluster_genesets() for graph-based decomposition (typically 0.15 to 0.4 for positive, and -0.4 to -0.15 for negative) ;; min_cnt_strg/min_cnt_vari=Minimum gene counts in create_signs() for strongly and variably correlated gene sets (typically 2 to 4) ;; threshold=Semantic similarity threshold in remove_signs_redundant() for merging redundant terms ;; weight_strg/weight_vari=Weight parameters in makeSignMatrix() for strongly and variably correlated gene sets (default is 0.5) ;; nrand_samples=Number of samples used for random sampling in compute_sepI_all() to calculate separation indices
- alternatives: Seurat package functions (such as ScaleData, RunPCA, FindNeighbors, FindClusters, and FindAllMarkers) are used as complementary tools for clustering, cell cycle scoring, and marker gene identification, but ASURAT's sign-by-sample matrix (SSM) and separation index (sepI) are preferred for functional/pathway-based clustering and interpretation.
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing single-cell RNA-seq datasets where you want to cluster cells and simultaneously characterize them using functional features (cell types, pathways, GO terms) rather than just individual gene expression profiles.
- pitfalls: Setting excessive values for remove_samples() arguments can produce biased results (e.g., min_nReads = 5000 is large and used only for the tutorial). Do not use the slot name "log-normalized" for altExp(sce) as it may cause errors when converting to Seurat objects using as.Seurat(). Avoid naive statistical tests on SSMs because row vectors are centered; use ASURAT's non-parametric separation index (compute_sepI_all or compute_sepI_clusters) instead. Setting th_posi and th_nega requires trial and error; exhaustive parameter searching is recommended.

workflows.name: multifaceted_sign_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform single-cell RNA-seq preprocessing, functional sign creation from databases, sign-by-sample matrix generation, clustering, and multifaceted visualization.
input: counts_matrix.csv (raw single-cell RNA-seq read count matrix with genes as rows and cells as columns)
database.rda (RDA files containing gene-to-biological-term mappings like Cell Ontology, MSigDB, GO, or KEGG)
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare SingleCellExperiment object and add metadata using add_metadata ;; 2. Perform quality control filtering on genes and cells using remove_variables, remove_samples, and remove_variables_second ;; 3. Normalize and center expression data ;; 4. Compute gene expression correlation matrix ;; 5. Load databases and define functional gene sets using remove_signs ;; 6. Cluster gene sets into strongly/variably correlated groups using cluster_genesets ;; 7. Create signs using create_signs and filter redundant or manual signs using remove_signs_redundant and remove_signs_manually ;; 8. Generate sign-by-sample matrices (SSMs) using makeSignMatrix ;; 9. Perform dimensional reduction (t-SNE) and cluster cells (using Seurat) ;; 10. Identify significant signs using compute_sepI_all and genes ;; 11. Visualize results using multifaceted heatmaps with plot_multiheatmaps and violin plots
workflows.code:
pbmc <- add_metadata(sce = pbmc, mitochondria_symbol = "^MT-")
pbmc <- remove_variables(sce = pbmc, min_nsamples = 10)
pbmc <- remove_samples(sce = pbmc, min_nReads = 5000, max_nReads = 20000, min_nGenes = 100, max_nGenes = 1e+10, min_percMT = 0, max_percMT = 10)
pbmc <- remove_variables_second(sce = pbmc, min_meannReads = 0.05)
assay(pbmc, "logcounts") <- log(assay(pbmc, "counts") + 1)
mat <- assay(pbmc, "logcounts")
assay(pbmc, "centered") <- sweep(mat, 1, apply(mat, 1, mean), FUN = "-")
sname <- "logcounts"
altExp(pbmc, sname) <- SummarizedExperiment(list(counts = assay(pbmc, sname)))
dictionary <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db, key = rownames(pbmc), columns = "ENTREZID", keytype = "SYMBOL")
dictionary <- dictionary[!duplicated(dictionary$SYMBOL), ]
rowData(pbmc)$geneID <- dictionary$ENTREZID
set.seed(1)
nrand_samples <- 1000
mat <- t(as.matrix(assay(pbmc, "centered")))
ids <- sample(rownames(mat), nrand_samples, prob = NULL)
cormat <- cor(mat[ids, ], method = "spearman")
pbmcs$CB <- remove_signs(sce = pbmcs$CB, min_ngenes = 2, max_ngenes = 1000)
pbmcs$GO <- remove_signs(sce = pbmcs$GO, min_ngenes = 2, max_ngenes = 1000)
pbmcs$KG <- remove_signs(sce = pbmcs$KG, min_ngenes = 2, max_ngenes = 1000)
set.seed(1)
pbmcs$CB <- cluster_genesets(sce = pbmcs$CB, cormat = cormat, th_posi = 0.30, th_nega = -0.30)
set.seed(1)
pbmcs$GO <- cluster_genesets(sce = pbmcs$GO, cormat = cormat, th_posi = 0.30, th_nega = -0.30)
set.seed(1)
pbmcs$KG <- cluster_genesets(sce = pbmcs$KG, cormat = cormat, th_posi = 0.20, th_nega = -0.20)
pbmcs$CB <- create_signs(sce = pbmcs$CB, min_cnt_strg = 2, min_cnt_vari = 2)
pbmcs$GO <- create_signs(sce = pbmcs$GO, min_cnt_strg = 4, min_cnt_vari = 4)
pbmcs$KG <- create_signs(sce = pbmcs$KG, min_cnt_strg = 3, min_cnt_vari = 3)
pbmcs$GO <- remove_signs_redundant(sce = pbmcs$GO, similarity_matrix = human_GO$similarity_matrix$BP, threshold = 0.70, keep_rareID = TRUE)
keywords <- "Covid|COVID"
pbmcs$KG <- remove_signs_manually(sce = pbmcs$KG, keywords = keywords)
pbmcs$CB <- makeSignMatrix(sce = pbmcs$CB, weight_strg = 0.5, weight_vari = 0.5)
pbmcs$GO <- makeSignMatrix(sce = pbmcs$GO, weight_strg = 0.5, weight_vari = 0.5)
pbmcs$KG <- makeSignMatrix(sce = pbmcs$KG, weight_strg = 0.5, weight_vari = 0.5)
pca_dims <- c(30, 30, 50)
tsne_dims <- c(2, 2, 3)
for(i in seq_along(pbmcs)){
  set.seed(1)
  mat <- t(as.matrix(assay(pbmcs[[i]], "counts")))
  res <- Rtsne::Rtsne(mat, dim = tsne_dims[i], pca = TRUE, initial_dims = pca_dims[i])
  reducedDim(pbmcs[[i]], "TSNE") <- res[["Y"]]
}
resolutions <- c(0.20, 0.20, 0.10)
ds <- list(seq_len(20), seq_len(20), seq_len(20))
for(i in seq_along(pbmcs)){
  surt <- Seurat::as.Seurat(pbmcs[[i]], counts = "counts", data = "counts")
  mat <- as.matrix(assay(pbmcs[[i]], "counts"))
  surt[["SSM"]] <- Seurat::CreateAssayObject(counts = mat)
  Seurat::DefaultAssay(surt) <- "SSM"
  surt <- Seurat::ScaleData(surt, features = rownames(surt))
  surt <- Seurat::RunPCA(surt, features = rownames(surt))
  surt <- Seurat::FindNeighbors(surt, reduction = "pca", dims = ds[[i]])
  surt <- Seurat::FindClusters(surt, resolution = resolutions[i])
  temp <- Seurat::as.SingleCellExperiment(surt)
  colData(pbmcs[[i]])$seurat_clusters <- colData(temp)$seurat_clusters
}
for(i in seq_along(pbmcs)){
  set.seed(1)
  labels <- colData(pbmcs[[i]])$seurat_clusters
  pbmcs[[i]] <- compute_sepI_all(sce = pbmcs[[i]], labels = labels, nrand_samples = 200)
}
set.seed(1)
plot_multiheatmaps(ssm_list = ssm_list, gem_list = gem_list, ssmlabel_list = ssmlabel_list, gemlabel_list = gemlabel_list, nrand_samples = 100, show_row_names = TRUE, title = "PBMC")
